free_text: The patient is a 71-year-old male with an elevated PSA of 8.1 and a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right peripheral zone, correlating with a prior biopsy Gleason 3+3 (ISUP Grade Group 1). The competing illness is not specified. Management assessment is active surveillance, balancing the potential benefit of intervention against the risks associated with the current pathological findings and patient preferences.
